rows.en:
Affinity ending.
Luis male filler.
rows.notes: Developer placeholder text under Alto's name plate; translated literally as c08701 / c05506.

rows.en:
(Kagura-kun gave me a letter...
C-could it be a love letter?!)
(Wait, this letter's from Luis-san?!)

(A letter? What's going on?
Let's see...)

(I came shopping in the Shibuya Area today,
but what should I buy?)
(Oh, he's gone...)
rows.notes: 17 uses; every one is the player watching Luis leave (frd_lis_101-104, scd_com_113).

rows.en:
(I'm curious what Luis-san was up to,
but I can't exactly go chasing after him.)
(Well, I'm gonna go enjoy some shopping.)

(I'm curious what Luis-san was up to,
but I can't exactly go chasing after him.)
(Well, I'm going to go enjoy some shopping.)

(I came to the Observation Pier on a whim,
but there's not much to do here.)

(Huh? Wait, it's Luis-san.
What's he doing in a place like this?)
(Well, I guess I'll head home too.)

(I came to the Observation Pier on a whim,
but there's not much to do here.)

(Huh? Wait, isn't that Luis-san?
What's he doing in a place like this?)
(Well, I guess I'll head home too.)
(What should I have for lunch...)

(But still, Luis-san...
Didn't he just come out of the shower room...?)

(W-well, no point worrying about it.
I'd better hurry and get ready for next class...)

(W-well, no point worrying about it.
I'd better hurry and get ready for next class...)

(Coming to Central Park always
puts my mind at ease.)

(But still, Luis-san...
Wasn't he just in a swimsuit...?)

(W-well, no point worrying about it...
I'll just enjoy my walk.)

(Coming to Central Park always
puts my mind at ease.)

(W-well, no point worrying about it...
I'll just enjoy my walk.)

(Deep Akihabara has all kinds of shops.
It's a fun place.)
rows.notes: Deep Akihabara is provisional in locations.json.

rows.en:
(Oh, he went into a shop...
What kind of place is it?)
(Let's see... A butler cafe......?)

(What business would Luis-san have
at a butler cafe...)

(W-well, no point worrying about it...
I'll enjoy exploring Deep Akihabara.)

(Deep Akihabara has all kinds of shops.
It's a fun place.)

(Oh, he went into a shop...
What kind of place is it, I wonder?)

(W-well, no point worrying about it...
I'll enjoy exploring Deep Akihabara.)

(Maybe I'll stop for tea at Silver Moon
on the way home.)
rows.notes: Silver Moon is provisional in locations.json.

rows.en:
(Huh? Wait, it's Luis-san.
Is he enjoying some tea by himself?)
(Oh, Luis-san left...)

(Luis-san having tea alone at a cafe...
Somehow it doesn't suit him...)

(Ha ha, oh well.
I'll enjoy some tea too.)

(Huh? Wait, isn't that Luis-san?
Is he enjoying some tea by himself?)
(Oh, Luis-san left...)

(Hee hee, oh well.
I'll enjoy some tea too.)

(I'm done shopping at Folmo.
Guess I'll head home soon...)
(Huh? Wait, it's Luis-san.)
rows.notes: 12 uses, one in a female scene; neutral wording.

rows.en:
(But wow, Luis-san was eating soft serve
with the biggest smile...)

(All right! I'll have some soft serve too
before I go home.)
(Huh? Wait, isn't that Luis-san?)

rows.en:
(But wow, Luis-san was eating soft serve

(All right! I'll have some soft serve too

(Griffith Park at dusk
feels kind of melancholy...)

(Huh, so even Luis-san gets wistful
like that sometimes...)

...Whoa, I was thinking about the Nyan-Nyan Dance,
and now look how late it's gotten...
Well, time to head home.

(N-Nyan-Nyan Dance? That's all
he was thinking about...)

(Oh well...
Okay, guess I'll head home too.)

All riiight! Burn, my passion!!
Fifty more laps around the field!

(Why is Luis-san training
at Mihoshi Academy?)
